_comment: Ratchet baseline for check_no_app_names.py. These counts may only go DOWN. The target for all four is zero: content reaches it at extraction (stage 7), imports at the AppSpec seams (stage 4), home_path_sites when every path in $HOME comes from config. `watched` is sticky on purpose, so an app that leaves the catalog is still scanned for leftovers.

content_files.because: Four app-owned query-key modules (birds/commute/location/health queries.ts) for the TanStack migration. Each app's cache keys and fetchers must live with the app: the alternative was putting them in the platform registry frontend/src/lib/queryKeys.ts, which would have raised literals in a PLATFORM file instead. imports and literals both held flat (20 / 302) across the whole migration, which is the point -- the platform learned nothing new about any app while 21 polls moved onto the cache. These four go to zero with their apps at stage 7, same as the seven from Stage 4.
